papers.title: Kafeneio scrap
lines: Tavli, the backgammon, in the shade of the coffee house. Greek coffee, black and thick.
The loser buys the coffee. The winner talks about it for a week.

papers.title: Buffer-zone note
lines: The Green Line runs through the middle of the island. In places it is a wall, in places a field.
At Pyla the villagers share a street. They share a coffee too, quietly.

papers.title: Halloumi note
lines: Halloumi: sheep's and goat's milk, folded with mint, fried until squeaky.
Cooked on a grill, it sings. Raw, it gossips. In a sandwich, it wins.

papers.title: Carob grower's note
lines: The carob pod was the 'locust bean', and the old weight of a carat came from its seeds.
So the gold you wear was once measured against a seed in a pod.
